## Common mistakes

> [!PITFALL]
> Code that mutates a list during iteration skips elements. The index no longer matches the original sequence.

> [!PITFALL]
> Avoid swallowing the exception before logging its cause. The caller otherwise loses the failure context.

> [!PITFALL]
> Logout handlers run after the response is committed. Their cleanup must tolerate an unavailable session.

```python
print("> [!PITFALL] inside code is not a rule")
```
